en: A colorized vintage view of a small alpine village nestled in green rolling hills and mountains. In the foreground are clustered stone and plaster houses with red-tiled roofs, and in the center rises a white church with a tall, slender steeple. Larger villa-like buildings stand to the right. The sky is pale blue with a pinkish horizon. At the top left, printed text reads "Malosco, Val di Non, Trentino."
